name: Sweet Starlight Sisters
source:
In a glittering corner of the city stands the stylish bar “BACCHUS.”

Having inherited the bar from his grandfather, the protagonist turns to a pair of childhood-friend sisters for help in livening up the place. Those sisters are Anya (the elder) and Sanya (the younger), both active as pole-dance performers.

On stage they dazzle the crowd with graceful techniques and star power. They aren’t prodigies, though—they’re always training hard to hone their skills. While working at the protagonist’s bar, the sisters polish their craft and aim to take first place in upcoming competitions.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4031520/Sweet_Starlight_Sisters/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在城市的一个闪闪发光的角落里，矗立着时尚的酒吧“BACCHUS”。

主角从祖父那里继承了酒吧，于是向一对儿时好友的姐妹寻求帮助，让这个地方变得活跃起来。这对姐妹是安雅（姐姐）和桑雅（妹妹），她们都是钢管舞表演者。

在舞台上，他们以优美的技巧和明星的力量让观众眼花缭乱。不过，他们并不是神童，他们总是努力训练来磨练自己的技能。在主角的酒吧工作期间，姐妹们磨练自己的手艺，目标是在即将到来的比赛中获得第一名。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4031520/Sweet_Starlight_Sisters/]Steam[/url]]
